signature_moves: Dark LED dot-matrix as an App Store leaderboard: a field of dark rounded-square cells with one lit vivid-green cell riding the top edge — a literal metaphor for an app climbing to #1 (Von Restorff isolation). BRAND LAYER ONLY; no evidence it appears in product UI.

psychology: Von Restorff / isolation effect — the single lit green cell against the dark grid, and the green stat pop, are the eye's landing points
First-impression thesis (Lindgaard 50ms) — the headline states the value ('Track Your App Store Rankings') immediately; the hero answers 'what is this' pre-attentively
Signal detection / accent-as-signal — green is reserved for the positive 'reached the top' meaning; everything else is white-on-black neutral, so the one accent carries all the signal
